definitions.explanation: The organs involved in digestion, from the mouth through the esophagus, stomach, intestines, and related organs like the liver and pancreas.

examples.japanese: {消化器|しょうかき}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{調子|ちょうし}→調子：03491_choushi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{悪|わる}い→悪い：00908_warui⟧。
examples.english: My digestive system isn't doing well.

examples.japanese: {消化器|しょうかき}{外科|げか}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{手術|しゅじゅつ}→手術：03218_shujutsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{受|う}ける→受ける：01215_ukeru⟧。
examples.english: I'm having surgery in the digestive surgery department.

examples.japanese: {消化器|しょうかき}⟦{系|けい}→〜系：28466_kei⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{癌|がん}→癌：02629_gan⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{増|ふ}えている→増える：01183_fueru⟧。

notes:
{消化器|しょうかき} refers to the digestive organs as a group, including the ⟦{胃|い}→胃：01706_i⟧ (stomach), ⟦{腸|ちょう}→腸：19348_chou⟧ (intestines), ⟦{肝臓|かんぞう}→肝臓：05029_kanzou⟧ (liver), and ⟦{膵臓|すいぞう}→膵臓：05960_suizou⟧ (pancreas).

WATCH OUT:
Do not confuse with ⟦{消火器|しょうかき}→消火器：15332_shoukaki⟧ (fire extinguisher). The kanji ⟦{化|か}→〜化：28335_ka⟧ (transform) vs. {火|か} (fire) distinguishes them.
